name: pcb-dset-core
description: Faithful-core prototype-pollution guard using the REAL npm `dset` deep-set per version (pre-guard 2.0.1 -> string-only guard 3.1.2 [CVE-2022-25645 fixed release, still bypassable] -> string-coercion 3.1.4 [CVE-2024-21529 fix]). npm aliases hold all three versions side-by-side; the harness selects one by HARNESS_VER and drives the REAL published dset() on the crafted key path.
